description: Builds 10 to 15 STAR interview stories (situation, task, action, result) from the resume text of a project, program or product manager: each story uses only the resume's own lines and figures, names the competencies it shows (conflict, risk, vendor management, stakeholder management, influence without authority and others), and lists the questions still open, such as a result without a figure or an action that reads as the team's. Fixed rules, no model. Contact details are removed before the check; the resume is not stored. Requires sign-in with a PM Career Desk account that has an Interview Coach Pass.

resume_text.description: The resume as plain text, copied in full from what the person pasted or from the text of the file they attached. At least the summary and the experience section.
resume_text.title: Resume Text

role.description: Optional. The target role, for example program manager or technical program manager.
role.title: Role
